items.text: Added new power grid rooms for Launch Site, Trainyard, and Radtown.
Livestock trust, gender, and status panel info are hidden by default and can be toggled by admins, with visibility now controlled server‑side.
Fixed livestock runtime pattern generation to match intended design ranges.
Improved livestock AI: cows no longer chase unreachable targets, herd and trough selection consider multiple options, bulls stop charging unreachable targets, and curious cows eat as expected.
Fixed turtle swimming movement, ensuring proper behavior in shallow water and preventing swimming into terrain.
Added inventory interaction sounds for animal fences.
Ladders now work correctly, restoring reliable climbing on structures.
Train tracks now generate smoother, passable junctions; impassable angles and confusing switches have been fixed.
Wolf skulls can no longer be harvested from farm animals, removing that loot source.
New meat type added to the loot table and a crash that prevented animals from being chased from behind has been fixed, improving AI behavior.
Inbred cows now display correct textures, fixing the visual mix‑up between healthy and inbred animals.
Grenade client prediction errors are now silently ignored, reducing disruptive prediction glitches.
Store items show loading placeholders generated from BlurHash, preventing blank images while textures load.
Store item tiles retain their cover images during loading, keeping UI appearance consistent.
Colored sky lanterns and boltie now have correct descriptions, fixing missing or typoed info.

2026-09-11.summary:
### World & Structures
- Added new power grid rooms for Launch Site, Trainyard, and Radtown.

### Livestock & Animal Systems
- Livestock trust, gender, and status panel info are hidden by default and can be toggled by admins, with visibility now controlled server‑side.
- Fixed livestock runtime pattern generation to match intended design ranges.
- Improved livestock AI: cows no longer chase unreachable targets, herd and trough selection consider multiple options, bulls stop charging unreachable targets, and curious cows eat as expected.
- Fixed turtle swimming movement, ensuring proper behavior in shallow water and preventing swimming into terrain.
- Added inventory interaction sounds for animal fences.

### Base Building
- Ladders now work correctly, restoring reliable climbing on structures.

### Transportation
- Train tracks now generate smoother, passable junctions; impassable angles and confusing switches have been fixed.

### Loot & Resources
- Wolf skulls can no longer be harvested from farm animals, removing that loot source.
- New meat type added to the loot table and a crash that prevented animals from being chased from behind has been fixed, improving AI behavior.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Inbred cows now display correct textures, fixing the visual mix‑up between healthy and inbred animals.
- Grenade client prediction errors are now silently ignored, reducing disruptive prediction glitches.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Store items show loading placeholders generated from BlurHash, preventing blank images while textures load.
- Store item tiles retain their cover images during loading, keeping UI appearance consistent.
- Colored sky lanterns and boltie now have correct descriptions, fixing missing or typoed info.

items.text: Fixed ladder climbing and moving‑train boarding on the Bradley flatbed by separating ladder and parenting triggers, enlarging volumes, and adding the flatbed to the manifest.
Cows no longer slide away when hurt or dying; they now stand up correctly and play the appropriate scramble animation.
Custom monument marker names are now correctly sent to Rust+, improving monument identification on the companion app.
Bulls can now defend their herd against other animals and protect their owner's base from other players, not just from players attacking the herd.
Fixed arrow collision detection, ensuring arrows now properly hit targets.
Added a new military tunnels loot room, providing additional high‑tier loot in tunnel networks.
Animals and sea turtles now deactivate when no players are nearby, reducing unnecessary activity.
Store UI now correctly displays pack overlay images on buttons and main sections.
Factory doors now render correctly in the store after successful image loading.
Skin tiles in the store now use CoverImage, fixing display issues and removing unused components.

2026-09-10.summary:
### Transportation & Vehicles
- Fixed ladder climbing and moving‑train boarding on the Bradley flatbed by separating ladder and parenting triggers, enlarging volumes, and adding the flatbed to the manifest.

### Animal Behavior
- Cows no longer slide away when hurt or dying; they now stand up correctly and play the appropriate scramble animation.

### Rust+ Integration
- Custom monument marker names are now correctly sent to Rust+, improving monument identification on the companion app.

### NPC & AI
- Bulls can now defend their herd against other animals and protect their owner's base from other players, not just from players attacking the herd.

### Combat
- Fixed arrow collision detection, ensuring arrows now properly hit targets.

### Loot & Resources
- Added a new military tunnels loot room, providing additional high‑tier loot in tunnel networks.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Animals and sea turtles now deactivate when no players are nearby, reducing unnecessary activity.

### UI & Store
- Store UI now correctly displays pack overlay images on buttons and main sections.
- Factory doors now render correctly in the store after successful image loading.
- Skin tiles in the store now use CoverImage, fixing display issues and removing unused components.

items.text: Animal purchases now correctly deduct scrap and cow selling price scales with genetic traits.
New sheep traits system added, influencing behavior and breeding.
Harvesting livestock now yields raw meat items (cow, bull, calf) with updated names/descriptions, and lamb meat (raw, cooked, spoiled) introduced with new assets.
Cows only heal when their needs are met, preventing trapped cows from staying healthy; stags now correctly respond to AI select/move commands.
Crate spawning bug in the small Easy cave fixed; crates now appear at the entrance instead of inside walls.
New loot rooms added: Power Grid rooms at Harbor 2 and additional rooms at Airfield and Harbor 1.
Building volume restrictions relaxed and construction sockets added, making sandbag barricade placement easier.
Sea turtles introduced with ocean locomotion similar to sharks; population settings corrected.
Bullets and arrows now collide with Oil Rig scientists' upper bodies and correctly register headshots instead of leg hits.
Fixed double playback of third‑person weapon sounds and applied correct sound assets for specific weapons.
Heavy plate helmet and diving mask overlays now persist when downed or dead; helmet audio muffling works correctly across snapshots.
Locomotive bell sound is now audible to all players, fixing a client‑only issue.
Players can now initiate phone conversations with NPCs, unlocking new interaction opportunities.
Fixed a save/load bug that could corrupt player progress.
Store pages now fall back to bundled UI assets if backend textures fail, preventing missing images.
Lighthouse interior reverb is no longer audible outdoors near the ladder, fixing audio bleed.
Refrigeration status refreshes instantly when items change containers, removing the previous delay and keeping spoilage timing accurate.
BBQ radial menu now correctly references the campfire, fixing misdirected interactions.

2026-09-09.summary:
### Livestock & Economy
- Animal purchases now correctly deduct scrap and cow selling price scales with genetic traits.
- New sheep traits system added, influencing behavior and breeding.
- Harvesting livestock now yields raw meat items (cow, bull, calf) with updated names/descriptions, and lamb meat (raw, cooked, spoiled) introduced with new assets.
- Cows only heal when their needs are met, preventing trapped cows from staying healthy; stags now correctly respond to AI select/move commands.

### World & Exploration
- Crate spawning bug in the small Easy cave fixed; crates now appear at the entrance instead of inside walls.
- New loot rooms added: Power Grid rooms at Harbor 2 and additional rooms at Airfield and Harbor 1.
- Building volume restrictions relaxed and construction sockets added, making sandbag barricade placement easier.
- Sea turtles introduced with ocean locomotion similar to sharks; population settings corrected.

### Combat & Damage
- Bullets and arrows now collide with Oil Rig scientists' upper bodies and correctly register headshots instead of leg hits.

### Audio & Sound
- Fixed double playback of third‑person weapon sounds and applied correct sound assets for specific weapons.
- Heavy plate helmet and diving mask overlays now persist when downed or dead; helmet audio muffling works correctly across snapshots.
- Locomotive bell sound is now audible to all players, fixing a client‑only issue.

### NPC & General
- Players can now initiate phone conversations with NPCs, unlocking new interaction opportunities.
- Fixed a save/load bug that could corrupt player progress.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Store pages now fall back to bundled UI assets if backend textures fail, preventing missing images.
- Lighthouse interior reverb is no longer audible outdoors near the ladder, fixing audio bleed.
- Refrigeration status refreshes instantly when items change containers, removing the previous delay and keeping spoilage timing accurate.
- BBQ radial menu now correctly references the campfire, fixing misdirected interactions.
